items.heading: ### 1. 相片匣
items.alt: 旧相片从木匣中如雪花般涌出的记忆场景
items.scene: An old wooden photo box springs open in the lower-left foreground. Dozens of worn family and school photographs burst upward and scatter through warm air like snowflakes; their tiny faces remain indistinct. A quiet old classroom and spring sunlight dissolve behind them. Dynamic diagonal composition, tactile paper edges, dust in the light.

items.heading: ### 2. 吹到今天的风
items.alt: 夜风吹过旧高中操场上的少年背影
items.scene: A Chinese high-school boy seen from behind on a modest mid-2000s school running track at night. Wind lifts the hem of his plain school jacket and nearby poplar leaves; classroom windows glow far away. The empty right half opens into a deep blue sky, conveying a wind that travels across many years.

items.heading: ### 3. 陪伴我死去
items.alt: 老人在未来房间中观看青春校园影像
items.scene: A restrained near-future room at dusk. An elderly silhouette sits quietly before a warm, life-size projection of a lively Chinese high-school campus from decades earlier. Cool gray walls contrast with golden remembered sunlight. Minimal technology, solemn and tender rather than cyberpunk.

items.heading: ### 4. 另一个人的生活
items.alt: 成年人观看二十年前初中生活的投影
items.scene: An adult Chinese man in side silhouette sits in a dim room, calmly watching grainy projected footage of a younger schoolboy crossing an old boarding-school courtyard twenty years ago. The adult and projection never touch; the distance between them is the subject. Quiet neutral emotion, film grain.

items.heading: ### 5. 眉头一动
items.alt: 清晨母亲牵着小学生走向旧校门
items.scene: Low child-height view of a mother holding a small boy's hand as they approach a weathered Chinese primary-school gate on a cool early-2000s morning. Focus on the joined hands, cloth backpack, long morning shadows and pale sunlight; faces are not shown.

items.heading: ### 6. 忽然毕业
items.alt: 毕业后人去楼空的大学宿舍
items.scene: An empty four-person Chinese university dormitory immediately after graduation. Bare bunk beds, rolled bamboo mats, dust rectangles where belongings stood, one taped cardboard box, and hard coastal afternoon light. No people. Wide quiet composition emphasizing abrupt absence.

items.heading: ### 7. 没有终结的歌声
items.alt: 有线耳机唤醒旧日操场与青春记忆
items.scene: Close-up of a worn portable CD player and wired earphones on a bus seat at night. The headphone cable flows into translucent memories of a school football field, a dorm window and summer streetlights, as if music physically pulls the past into the present. No musical notes or text.

items.heading: ### 8. 看她到天亮
items.alt: 凌晨自习室里女孩写线性代数男孩趴桌凝望
items.scene: A nearly empty university study room at 4 a.m. Blue dawn enters through tall windows. A young woman concentrates on a linear-algebra notebook while a tired young man rests his head on the adjacent desk, quietly looking toward her. Side-rear view, fluorescent fatigue rather than romantic glamour; equations are abstract and unreadable.

items.heading: ### 9. 雨更大了
items.alt: 校园暴雨中独自撑伞的男孩与奶茶
items.scene: A lone young Chinese man under an umbrella on a university road during heavy tropical rain. A sealed cup of red-bean milk tea hangs unused from his hand; streetlamp reflections stretch across flooded pavement. Dense rain erases the campus background. Only one person, restrained heartbreak.

items.heading: ### 10. 用完的力气
items.alt: 绿皮火车上耗尽力气后熟睡的年轻人
items.scene: Inside an old Chinese green train at sunset, a dusty young traveler sleeps against the window after years of restless journeys. A canvas backpack, paper tickets and a thermos sit nearby. Warm fading light, rough upholstery, complete exhaustion mixed with contentment.

items.heading: ### 11. 风的律动
items.alt: 佛山夏夜街头两个年轻人迎风聊天
items.scene: Two young Chinese tutors walk down a quiet Foshan street after midnight, talking freely beneath banyan trees and old shop awnings. Humid pavement reflects sparse lamps; warm wind lifts loose shirts while the dark sky feels unusually open. Wide low-angle composition, modest neighborhood not commercial glamour.

items.heading: ### 12. 青春小城堡
items.alt: 办公桌上由快乐记忆筑成的微光城堡
items.scene: On a cluttered internship desk between a laptop, fruit container and visitor badge, a small translucent castle made of warm light rises from snapshots of friends, food and summer streets. The surrounding office stays realistic and slightly lonely. Magical realism, not a toy castle.

items.heading: ### 13. 融入血液的四季
items.alt: 火烧云蝉鸣初雪暴雨交织成生命四季
items.scene: Poetic four-season editorial collage: fire-colored clouds, a cicada shell in summer leaves, first snow on an office path, and sudden rain over a campus. Thin warm red streams connect the four scenes like memory circulating through a life, symbolic rather than anatomical.

items.heading: ### 14. 我也曾经22岁
items.alt: 疲惫成年人影子里奔跑着二十二岁的自己
items.scene: A late-twenties Chinese programmer sits at a modest desk after dark, tired but not defeated. His long shadow on the wall becomes the lively silhouette of his twenty-two-year-old self running through a Guangzhou alley. Double exposure, gentle self-mockery rather than despair.

items.heading: ### 15. 燥热晚风
items.alt: 北京燥热街道上变得轻柔的晚风
items.scene: A tree-lined Beijing avenue after work in a hot orange evening. A young intern walks lightly through the crowd while a visible ribbon of cool blue air bends leaves and shirt fabric around him. Natural city realism with one subtle poetic wind motif.

items.heading: ### 16. 地中海边的梦
items.alt: 地中海悬崖公路上独自骑行的剪影
items.scene: A solitary cyclist is a small silhouette on a sun-bleached cliff road above the Mediterranean between Malaga and Nerja. Vast cobalt sea, white heat and shimmering air dominate the frame. Dreamlike overexposure, no sports-advertising polish, no logos.

items.heading: ### 17. 没有长大的妹妹
items.alt: 广东早茶桌上为未长大女孩留下的空位
items.scene: A sunlit Guangdong morning-tea table with bamboo steamers and tea. One chair remains empty; rising steam briefly suggests the soft outline of a young adult woman who might have lived this ordinary life. Bright, warm and unreachable, never ghostly or frightening.

items.heading: ### 18. 水沟里的孩子
items.alt: 无人注意的水泥排水沟与求生的小手
items.scene: High vertical view into a narrow mossy concrete drainage channel in a small Chinese town. Dark water and hard geometric walls surround one small child's hand reaching toward daylight; no face, no injury, no graphic distress. The ordinary street above continues unaware.

items.heading: ### 19. 死后的工作消息
items.alt: 深夜空工位上不断亮起工作提醒的手机
items.scene: A silent dark office cubicle at 2 a.m. An unattended phone on the desk repeatedly glows with stacked work-notification shapes, the only light in the frame. Empty chair, cold monitor and untouched mug; no body, no readable app names or text.

items.heading: ### 20. 年纪轻轻
items.alt: 人生刻度在中途骤然中断的概念画面
items.scene: Minimal conceptual editorial image: a long human-life timeline made from worn paper and soft daylight abruptly tears near its middle, while two contradictory shadows label youth and age only through visual scale, with no readable numbers or words. Quiet black, gray and warm ivory palette.

items.heading: ### 21. 生物之先
items.alt: 灰色工位中仍有温暖生命脉搏的人
items.scene: Rows of gray office cubicles reduce workers to small system-like shapes. One ordinary person stands in warm natural light with a subtle pulse of red-gold life visible through the chest as light, not anatomy. Emphasize breathing, warmth and biological dignity; non-graphic.

items.heading: ### 22. 平静午后的岔路
items.alt: 平静午后里通向不同人生的十字路口
items.scene: An utterly ordinary Chinese city crossroads on a calm sunny afternoon. One person pauses almost imperceptibly while two roads continue into different future atmospheres. A single leaf drifts through still air. No storm or drama; the significance is invisible in the moment.

items.heading: ### 23. 决定之后
items.alt: 做出重大决定后在床上沉沉睡去的人
items.scene: Top-down view of an exhausted young Chinese man in loosened travel clothes falling fully asleep across a plain white hotel bed after making a life-changing decision. A train ticket lies folded on the bedside table; late-afternoon light cuts across the room. Peace after depletion, no anguish.

items.heading: ### 24. 有时效性的青春
items.alt: 北京出租屋里被时间标记的青春静物
items.scene: Still life by the window of a narrow but ordinary Beijing rental: an open travel notebook, an aging transit card, a half-finished drink and a calendar losing pages in moving air. High-rises outside. The objects suggest that receptiveness to beauty has a limited season, without readable dates.

items.heading: ### 25. 小型避难所
items.alt: 冷色办公室中被杯子和私人物件筑起的温暖工位
items.scene: In a large cool-toned open office, one modest cubicle forms a warm island: seven mismatched cups, tissues, tea, a small plant, personal notes without readable writing, and a soft desk lamp. The seat is empty but deeply lived-in. Intimate realism, not an executive office.

items.heading: ### 26. 云还是在那里
items.alt: 办公室玻璃外依旧宏大的云
items.scene: Office cubicle tops occupy only the lower quarter of the frame. Beyond a large window, monumental white summer clouds remain luminous and unchanged. A faint reflection of a quiet observer appears in the glass, almost disappearing. Spacious, contemplative composition.

items.heading: ### 27. 古法编程
items.alt: 蒙尘旧显示器里的手写代码正在消散
items.scene: A dusty old monitor and mechanical keyboard sit abandoned at the edge of a modern office. Faint green code-like lines on the screen dissolve into dust and dry vines, symbolizing a once-proud craft being discarded. No readable code, no neon cyberpunk.

items.heading: ### 28. 赤手空拳
items.alt: 会议室里被透明预案护甲包围的人
items.scene: An ordinary office worker sits alert in a tense meeting room. Around his empty hands and shoulders, translucent layers of rehearsed possibilities form a subtle protective shell of light. The armor is clearly mental and abstract, with no physical weapons or violence.

items.heading: ### 29. 九泉把酒
items.alt: 雪地孤坟旁两位江湖人把酒诀别
items.scene: Fictional Chinese wuxia landscape in restrained ink-and-cinema realism: two weathered swordsmen sit beside a lonely grave under a bare tree and share small cups in falling snow before a final separation. Wide 3:2 composition, simple period clothing, solemn friendship, no combat.

items.heading: ### 30. 无处核实的消失
items.alt: 黄昏雪地里逐渐被风抹平的脚印
items.scene: At northern dusk, a trail of footprints across a bleak snowfield gradually disappears under windblown powder. A barely visible human shape is already merging with the horizon. Extremely simple perspective, muted gray-blue and brown, no identifiable face.

items.heading: ### 31. 泪水两行
items.alt: 边境哨卡前无声回头落泪的男人
items.scene: Fictional dystopian checkpoint at twilight. A man has stopped and turned his head back; two quiet tear tracks catch alternating cold and warm security lights. Fences and document fragments blur behind him. Close portrait without resemblance to any real person, silent farewell, no violence.

items.heading: ### 32. 银色怀表
items.alt: 粗糙手掌中嵌着家庭照片的磨损银怀表
items.scene: Extreme close-up of a rough hand holding an open, scratched silver pocket watch. Inside is a tiny faded warm-toned photograph of two adults and a baby with indistinct faces. Cold checkpoint wire and concrete blur in the background. The worn object carries the whole tragedy.

items.heading: ## 🍜 美食榜 · 出镜率最高的食物
items.alt: 深夜街边冒热气的拌面奶茶与鸡蛋灌饼
items.scene: Editorial food still life in a humble late-night South China eatery: a steaming bowl of mixed noodles is the hero, with a red-bean milk tea, egg-filled flatbread and another bowl of pork-trotter noodles around it. Warm tungsten light, scratched tabletop, youthful memory, appetizing but not luxury food photography.

items.heading: ## 😂 名场面榜 · 最搞笑的十个瞬间
items.alt: 音箱复仇鸡蛋装置和天台蜡烛组成的漫画分镜
items.scene: Playful four-panel editorial illustration with no text: an oversized smart speaker blasting in a shared apartment, a wooden egg-protection contraption breaking on impact, a young man fumbling with candles on a rooftop, and a sleepy late-night study table. Expressive anonymous figures, warm comic timing, no brand logos.

items.heading: ## 😢 催泪榜 · 最让人心酸的瞬间
items.alt: 北京西站人潮中握着退票凭证的孤独背影
items.scene: A vast Beijing railway-station concourse at evening. Crowds stream toward departure gates while one exhausted young man stands still in the foreground holding a folded, canceled ticket. Deep perspective and fluorescent distance make the quiet choice feel enormous; no readable signage or text.

items.heading: ## 🗺️ 足迹榜 · 作者去过的城市/地点
items.alt: 摊开的旅行手账与跨越中国到西班牙的路线
items.scene: Top-down travel-journal still life: a hand-drawn but deliberately non-literal outline of journeys across China toward Spain, train tickets, an old compact camera, bicycle gloves, metro cards and pressed leaves. Colored threads connect memories without readable place names. Personal archive, not a navigational map.

items.heading: ## 👥 人物榜 · 贯穿全书的重要角色
items.alt: 校园操场与工位之间不同人生阶段的人物剪影
items.scene: Anonymous multi-generation ensemble seen as backlit silhouettes across one continuous setting that shifts from a school track to a university path and office corridor. A teacher, parents, classmates, partner and colleagues are distinguished by posture and objects, never by identifiable faces. Warm sunset continuity.

items.heading: ## 📖 文体榜 · 作者尝试过的写作风格
items.alt: 手稿在回忆录武侠代码与寓言场景间变化
items.scene: An author's desk where blank manuscript pages transform into several visual worlds: memoir snapshots, an ink-wash wuxia ridge, a cold dystopian checkpoint, abstract code, and a city survival diagram. Cohesive editorial collage, no readable writing, one fountain pen at the center.

items.heading: ## 🎮 游戏榜 · 文中提到的游戏
items.alt: 旧网吧到掌机时代的游戏设备变迁
items.scene: A timeline-like gaming still life from an old Chinese internet-cafe keyboard and wired mouse to a modern handheld console, generic cartridges and controller on a lived-in desk. Colored screen glow suggests many gaming eras without depicting copyrighted characters, game logos or readable titles.

items.heading: ## 💼 打工榜 · 作者的职业经历
items.alt: 从家教书桌到游戏公司和大厂工位的工作变迁
items.scene: Three-stage horizontal editorial scene: tutoring papers and a bowl of late-night noodles, a cramped Guangzhou game-development desk, and a modern Beijing office cubicle with many cups. One ordinary worker moves through all three stages. Honest labor and fatigue, no corporate logos.

items.heading: ## 🧠 预案榜 · 脑内演练最密集的场景
items.alt: 平静工位背后展开丧尸屋顶武侠与裁员预演
items.scene: An office worker sits normally at a desk while translucent imagined stages unfold behind him: moving across rooftops during a fictional emergency, practicing a wuxia stance, laughing after layoff news, and holding a black thermos like a shield. Clearly mental rehearsal, witty not violent, no gore.

items.heading: ## 🤖 AI 焦虑榜 · 技术时代的新情绪
items.alt: 代码云快速生成而程序员逐渐失去掌控感
items.scene: Cold contemporary editorial illustration: a programmer's hands direct a vast cloud of automatically assembling code-like fragments while the person becomes a small observer beside a system he cannot touch. Success indicators glow, but the human expression is hollow. No robots, handshakes, logos or readable code.

items.heading: ## 🏫 考试榜 · 作者经历过的重大考试
items.alt: 跑道上的体测号码牌与被雨水打湿的答题纸
items.scene: Top-down still life on a wet running track: a crumpled exam admission slip, an athletics number bib, a pencil, an unfinished answer sheet and a small oxygen mask at the edge. The lanes lead away toward distant school gates. No readable names or numbers, fate rather than motivation.

items.heading: ## 🌡️ 受伤榜 · 作者经历过的身体伤害
items.alt: 急救箱自行车头盔与烈日下的受伤记忆静物
items.scene: Restrained non-graphic first-aid still life: a small medical kit, bicycle helmet, sun-faded glove, gauze, old firecracker paper and a childhood doorframe mark arranged in harsh Mediterranean sunlight fading into cool indoor shadow. No blood, wounds or exposed injury.

items.heading: ## 🏆 金句密度榜 · 当前评审精选最密集的文章
items.alt: 钢笔墨迹与密集发光句子组成的编辑设计
items.scene: Graphic editorial still life of a fountain pen releasing dense luminous lines and punctuation-like marks across layered paper, suggesting memorable sentences accumulating faster than the page can hold them. Elegant monochrome ink with warm gold highlights, no readable words or fake typography.

items.heading: ## 🎵 音乐榜 · 融入灵魂的那些歌
items.alt: 旧磁带CD与有线耳机连接不同年代的青春
items.scene: Macro still life of a cassette, scratched compact discs, wired earphones and a tiny radio on a bedroom desk. The loose tape ribbon flows into faint scenes of football, school singing and sleepless dorm nights. Warm analog light, no album art, artists or readable song titles.

items.heading: ## 💕 心动榜 · 那些年怦然心动的瞬间
items.alt: 深夜快餐店里课本奶茶与相邻的年轻身影
items.scene: Inside a generic 24-hour fast-food restaurant before dawn, two university students sit at neighboring tables under warm window light. Open mathematics textbooks and two red-bean milk teas rest between them; one studies while the other quietly watches. Tender distance, no embrace, no brand logos.

items.heading: ## 💰 金钱榜 · 书里出现过的那些数字
items.alt: 账本硬币相机和车票构成的人生价格静物
items.scene: Editorial tabletop of an old ledger, mixed coins and receipts, a used camera with scratches, a monthly transit card, a tutoring notebook and a hospital envelope. Dramatic differences in scale suggest small wages and absurd claims without any readable numbers or currency branding.

items.heading: ## 📱 数码榜 · 被偷、被卖、被珍藏的电子产品
items.alt: 有划痕的旧手机相机卡带与智能音箱静物
items.scene: Used-electronics still life with visible history: a small older smartphone, scratched rangefinder-style camera, generic handheld game cartridges, wired headphones and a compact smart speaker. Price stickers are blank, surfaces show wear, warm window light, no logos or copyrighted product interface.

items.heading: ## 👨‍🏫 恩师与领导榜 · 塑造与折磨过他的人
items.alt: 粉笔黑板与会议室长桌交叠出的两种权威
items.scene: Split diagonal editorial scene: on one side an empty classroom blackboard, chalk, worn lesson plan and warm morning light; on the other a cold corporate meeting table, performance folders and abandoned game chips. Authority that teaches versus authority that consumes, no faces, no readable text.
